title: C-4 — worker_{node_id}_{run_id}.jsonl (Person A)
description:
All durations are worker-local engine clocks.

Prefill/decode split is obtainable without streaming: vLLM exposes per-request arrival/first-scheduled/first-token/finished times on its output object, and llama.cpp's server returns a timings block with prompt and predicted milliseconds. If either turns out NOT to expose it on your pinned version, log service_ns only and record F-18 as PARTIALLY SATISFIED in the manifest rather than faking the split.

prefill_ns.description: Omit if the pinned engine version does not expose it (F-18 partial).

decode_ns.description: Omit if the pinned engine version does not expose it (F-18 partial).

batch_size_at_admission.description: F-4: routing considers the COMPOSITION of a target's in-flight set, not only its depth.

kv_occupancy_at_admission.description: Omit or -1.0 where the engine does not expose it.
